messages:
neha: Heads up — DiskWatermarkHigh firing for router-prod nodes in us-west-2. Seeing ~20 alerts in the last 10m. Anyone know where the router dashboard is and whether we should bump thresholds or put a short quiet window?

owen: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/router/Router-Cluster?orgId=1&var-cluster=router-prod. Usually transient but want the panels. Are these actual disk growths or IO bursts from a job?

sre-bot: Incident detected: DiskWatermarkHigh (severity: P2) — fired 19 times in 10m. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/disk-watermark-high

maria: I can investigate. neha can you paste the top offending nodes / any panel snapshot? Also try: `kubectl top pods -n router | sort -k3 -nr | head` to check pod CPU/IO contenders.

neha: Pasting quick notes — node fs.used_percent jumped 72% -> 89% on nodes router-a,b,c over ~6m. Pods on those nodes show heavy IO from `kv-sync` job (batch window landed at :12).

kai: If it's kv-sync windows, pattern is known. Suggest short-term threshold adjustment rather than permanent rule change. Proposed Prom tweak for a temporary window (example):
```yaml
expr: (node_filesystem_used_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes) * 100 > 92
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: warning
```
That corresponds to ~8% available. Also add `snoozed_by=eng-platform` tag in a silence.

andrew: +1 for temporary silence instead of rule change. I'll create a 2h silence scoped to `alertname=DiskWatermarkHigh,cluster=router-prod` so we stop getting paged while we confirm. Command I use: `amtool silence --match 'alertname=DiskWatermarkHigh,cluster=router-prod' --end '2h'`

maria: Creating silence now and will annotate the dashboard. Will also add a reminder task to follow up on kv-sync sharding.

neha: :thumbsup: Please post the silence id here and add a quick note in the runbook about scheduled kv-sync spikes. Also file infra-ticket if root cause looks like mis-sharding.

sre-bot: Silence created: ID abc123-silence — scope: alertname=DiskWatermarkHigh,cluster=router-prod — ends in 2h. Created by maria.

owen: Thanks folks. I'll add a short runbook entry recommending a 2h silence during kv-sync maintenance windows and link the infra-ticket once created. If alerts persist after silence ends, escalate to oncall.
